Practical details.

A clear page plan

Responsive layouts

Before we begin

Bring the essentials.
We’ll shape the detail.

A short description of your business, the people you want to reach and what visitors should do is enough to start a brief.

  • Your logo, images and existing website, if you have them
  • Services and business details you can confirm
  • Who will supply and approve the words and images
  • Any required features, dates and budget constraints

We agree editing needs and platform choices before building. Account ownership, content rights and handover arrangements belong in the project scope.

Before the next step

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Can I edit the website myself?

We discuss what you want to change and how often before choosing the platform. Editing access, instructions and any ongoing help are agreed as part of the scope.

Do I need finished content to start?

No. We can begin with an outline and identify the gaps. Who prepares the final wording and images, and when they are needed, is agreed before the build. You approve the business information.

How much will it cost, and how long will it take?

Pages, content, functionality and existing setup all affect the work. We confirm the fee, review stages and schedule after understanding the brief, including dependencies on content and approvals.

What if I want something extra later?

We review the request against the agreed scope and explain any change to cost or timing before proceeding. Smaller content changes may fit an optional care allowance; new pages or features need separate agreement.
